from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib
directory = Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round165-p6-author-report-clone-disposition-20261013")
plan = json.loads((directory / "plan.json").read_text())

unchanged = []
for item in plan["inputs"]:
    if item["path"] in targets:
        continue
    raw = Path(item["path"]).read_bytes()
    assert len(raw) == item["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == item["sha256"], item["path"]
    unchanged.append(item["path"])
ledger = json.loads(Path(plan["ledger_path"]).read_text())
assert len(ledger["commands"]) == 15 and ledger["old_budget_resets"] == 0
for name, item in ledger["commands"].items():
    expected = (1, 0, "SPENT") if name == "mypy_baseline" else (0, 1, "HELD")

outputs = []

    raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
    if name.endswith(".json"):
